files.description:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in his circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming him as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.2% 
No major infection symptom yet to appear on body's surface, but testing found internal infection. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.3u/L 
Infection is more severe within organs than in subject's circulatory system.

Greyy was born in a city in Bolívar. His father was an unskilled worker and his mother worked in a care home. Both of them were in poor health. With both parents earning very little, the family barely made ends meet.
Greyy's childhood was much different from that of his peers. He is introverted and practical like his father, and he is physically weak like his mother. However, Greyy has a knack for Arts. He would have had a promising career on the back of his talent, would that he didn't get infected.

Greyy is decently skilled in the use of electricity and Originium. By quickly increasing the voltage of an operating unit, he can make the positive and negative ions collide and create energy. 
He learned about Originium from his mother, though he is unsure why an ordinary person like her would have had such a detailed knowledge of Arts. 
He lived in a slum that suffered from regular blackouts. Because of this, Greyy decided to collect discarded Originium fragments near a smelting plant. He focused their energy into his staff to create a temporary light source. 
The staff, of course, was also made using repurposed materials.

Greyy lost his family, so joining Rhodes Island has an extra special meaning for him. His mastery of electrical energy Arts got him a job maintaining the generators at Rhodes Island.
Greyy is honest, quiet, deferential and always grateful that he gets to be of help to Rhodes Island. 
Perros are known for their loyalty. Even unlucky Perros who are infected, like Greyy, will cherish any companions who share the same difficult and lonely path.

[Classified Log] 
Information about the whereabouts of Greyy's parents has not yet been obtained. Perhaps they have passed away. Perhaps they have been taken into quarantine. After all, his parents were both infected, so it is safe to say he probably caught the infection from them. In any case, it is imperative we help him adapt to life at Rhodes Island. Even if kids his age are aware of the fate of their loved ones, learning the truth can have a negative impact on their mental state. Taking care of these children, guiding them, and changing their destiny is your responsibility, Doctor. Certainly, your duties aren't easy. Sometimes even I think the load is too heavy for you to bear. But don't children like Greyy make you believe there's still hope?

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hi, Doctor. If you need anything, please tell me...  Um, I assume you still remember my code name...?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doc-Doctor, hi... Um, I just checked the Medical Department's power grid, and taking some files around while I'm at it... No, nobody's forcing me! I mean, they take such good care of me, it's the least I can do for them...

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I decided to learn electric Arts just so my friends back in the slums could have some light, just so the nights would be a little less miserable... That pitch black, it's really scary. And the kinds of people who live in the dark, they can be scary too...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: These Originium generators here at Rhodes Island are amazing... You know, if we had anything like them back home, we wouldn't need to live in the dark all the time, like life without light is normal.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: My mother taught me the basics of Arts. She told me I use Arts just like she did when she was younger, but I'm also as sickly as she was... If she were still alive, I'd hope she could come with me to Rhodes Island...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Doctor, before I got the training from you, all I could do with my Arts was light up one little room. But now that little spark has turned into something that can help lots of people...! Thank you so much!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Huh? A current anomaly in Miss Mayer's storeroom? W-why is it her again... What? Dr. Kal'tsit wants more cables for her lab? And another outage in Ifrit's room? Waahhhh... Doctor, help meee...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Zzz... Wha? Doctor...? Ah! Sorry! I wasn't napping! I, um, I was... Oh, is this Medical?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, are you going out again...? Okay, I know. I'll wait here for you... Um, Doctor, please hurry back...

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Whoa...! Aaaugh... Static electricity. Gave me a jolt...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: H-Hi. My name is Greyy. I'm kind of an electrician... Erm, th-thanks for taking me on...!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: C-could you pause it for a minute? I-I'm taking notes…

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Okay, I'll take it to... Huh? It's, it's for me...? Really?

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Hehe. Doctor, I shall light the way for you!... Um, sorry, just got too full of myself...  But I actually mean it...!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Everyone, I'm here to help...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'm the Captain...? O-Okay! If that's your wish, Doctor!...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Let me handle the logistical support...!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Doctor, I see the enemies rallying...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I'll try my best…

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I should be able to do it...!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Slowly, and carefully...

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Can't tiwst my ankle now!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Stop being evil!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I won't let you hurt my friends...!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: T-Take that!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: An electric shock c-can really hurt...!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, we've done a wonderful job...! Cou-Could we go home now?...

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: We-We won, Doctor!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, the ones who ran off... We won't see them again, will we?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Err... Doctor...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: What am I doing today?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Whoa…

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, you're really tall... I-I wonder when I'll get to be that tall...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. Well, er... there's a fireworks show coming up, and I was wondering if we could watch it together. Yes, I like fireworks. They're so small, yet so bright and colorful, shining over the land...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, you're back!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Here's my birthday present for you, Doctor... Um, I didn't have the money to buy anything nice, so I made something myself... a candle that won't be blown out. May it light a corner of your room and never go out.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor... I've been studying electrical engineering in depth lately. It's a little tough... but I'll work hard! I want to illuminate more places for Rhodes Island, and for everyone... I, I'm sorry, I'm getting ahead of myself, aren't I?
